moments.evidence: full finite input enumeration, analytic Gaussian gain/noise elimination

information.sharing: all q paths and difference steps evaluated on the same q=0 draws; each row is one independent channel+data+noise draw
information.uncertainty: information and KL integrations are Monte Carlo with independent batch SE; algebraic score comparisons are deterministic
information.truth_boundary: gain/word/noise saved only as simulator audit; score and feature APIs consume y and declared working model

inputs.code: binary repetition constraints within the four I bits and within the four Q bits
inputs.pilot: first DAFT symbol fixed at (1+j)/sqrt(2), others uniform
